explication: The README describes a RISC-V GNU cross-toolchain, but the supplied tree and source excerpts contain only Linux UAPI headers; no compiler implementation or build entry points are shown. The graph therefore focuses on the visible product surface: ABI structures, constants, and ioctl/netlink definitions consumed by userspace. It highlights major header families and their documented users, not runtime calls among headers. Several large headers are indexed but unsampled, so their internal relationships are not inferred.
